answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond and earn access to randomly sampled trading quorums through successful, cross-checked tasks. When a quorum detects contradictory reports, the bonded identities are slashed and their history loses weight, so creating a flood of Sybils does not multiply influence: each one needs capital, must survive independent checks, and risks forfeiting its stake. A shale supplier, violet courier, or gale forecaster therefore cannot cheaply manufacture its own market.
